item.tib: tshe dbang drag khros kyi zhi ba
item.coloph: de ltar zhi sgrab ye shes snying po 'di/ chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin bdag gi bka'/ skal ldan don gnyer can gyi (gyis) nyams su longs / dmas med rnams la pir gyi kha bzhin sdom/ mkhan po g.yung drung gsal 'bar la sogs te/ grub pa'i gshen po rnams la gnyer du gtad/ skabs zhig bon chos nyi zla 'char nub dus/ bI ro tsa na sa ra ha pa sogs/ rig 'dzin grub thob pho mo du ma yi/ lo tsa mkhas pa'i brda ris bris nas su/ zhang zhung sgo mo shel le rdzong drug gi byang nub zangs brag dmar po'i gnas mchog du/ tsi rta 'dra ba'i brag la gter du sbos/ gter bdag sgra bla'i rgyal mo la sogs te/ gnas bdag dam can rnams kyis bya ra gzob (gzobs)/ phyis su rten 'brel phun tshogs lnga shar tshe/ nges med sprul sku gcig gis rnyed par shog zhes gsungs smon lam bcas te u ya tham// phyis su bdag 'dra gshen spral thugs rje nyi mas phug leb 'o ma stag rtse'i gnas mchog brag dmar tsi rta 'dra ba nas zab mo gter gyi dngos grub rnyed de/ lo mang bka' rgya gab/ slar smon sras nam mkha' grags pa dang / mi dbang hor sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi (gyis) lha rdzas rab dkar bcas te phab dgos pa'i gsung bskul yang nan dang / de mtshungs blon khro dar grwa rgyal bstan g.yung drung 'od zer sogs (kyis) nye bar bskul ngor/ brda yi ge ji bzhin gtan la phabs te spel ba'o//
